text.TEN AI가 무료로 배포하는 오피스 프로그램 한판과 보안키의 이용 조건: The conditions for using Hanpan, the free office program from TEN AI, and its security keys: getting, registering and revoking keys, and what Hanpan sends.
These are the conditions that apply when you use Hanpan and security keys.
text.이 조건은 TEN AI(이하 ‘회사’)가 무료로 배포하는 「한판」과, 회: These terms set out the conditions for using Hanpan, which TEN AI (the “Company”) distributes free of charge, and the security keys the Company issues to members. Anything not covered here follows the
text.보안키는 tenai.kr 회원이 회원 페이지에서 이 조건에 동의한 뒤 받: A tenai.kr member can get a security key on the member page after agreeing to these terms.
text.회원 한 사람이 가질 수 있는 보안키는 폐기하지 않은 것을 기준으로 3개: Each member can hold up to 3 security keys that have not been revoked.
text.짧은 시간에 보안키를 지나치게 많이 받거나 폐기하는 경우, 회사는 그날의: If a member gets or revokes an excessive number of keys in a short time, the Company may limit issuance for that day.
text.보안키는 한판 Windows판에만 쓰입니다. Mac판과 Linux판은 보: Security keys are used only by Hanpan for Windows. Hanpan for Mac and Linux works without a key.
text.보안키 하나는 기기 하나(USB 저장장치 또는 PC)에만 등록할 수 있습: Each security key can be registered on only one device (a USB drive or a PC). Registration needs an internet connection.
Once registered, Hanpan checks the key's status over the internet once a day.
text.30일 넘게 확인하지 못하면 한판이 잠길 수 있습니다. 이때 인터넷에 연: If Hanpan cannot check for more than 30 days, it may lock. Starting Hanpan again while connected to the internet checks the key and opens it again.
text.USB에 등록한 경우 그 USB를 꽂아야 한판이 열립니다. PC 시계가: If the key is registered on a USB drive, Hanpan opens only with that drive plugged in. Hanpan may not open if the PC clock is far off.
Do not give, lend or share a security key with anyone else.
Do not forge or alter a security key file.
Do not repeatedly send abnormal requests to the security key server.
text.제4조 (분실과 회원의 폐기): Article 4 (Loss and revocation by the member)
text.회원은 회원 페이지에서 언제든 자기 보안키를 폐기할 수 있습니다. 보안키: Members can revoke their own security keys at any time on the member page. If you lose a key file, revoke it and get a new one.
text.폐기한 보안키로 등록한 한판은 다음 확인 때(하루 안에) 잠깁니다. 폐기: Hanpan registered with a revoked key locks at its next check (within a day). A revoked key cannot be restored.
text.회사는 제3조를 어긴 것이 확인된 경우, 또는 이용약관에 따라 회원 자격: The Company may revoke a security key if a breach of Article 3 is confirmed, or if the member loses membership under the Terms of Use.
text.회사는 폐기하기 7일 전에 가입한 이메일로 사유를 알리고, 그동안 회원의: The Company will email the reason to the member's registered address 7 days before revoking, and accept the member's explanation during that time. However, where forgery or sharing among several people is confirmed and must be stopped at once, the Company revokes first and notifies right away.
When a member cancels their membership, all of their security keys are revoked.
text.제6조 (보안키 서버의 점검과 중단): Article 6 (Maintenance and outages of the key server)
text.보안키 확인 서버를 점검하거나 서버가 멈춰도, 이미 등록한 한판은 마지막: During maintenance or an outage of the key server, Hanpan that is already registered keeps working for 30 days from its last successful check. New registrations may not be possible during that time.
text.서버가 하루 넘게 멈추면 회사는 tenai.kr 에 알리고, 30일 안에: If the server is down for more than a day, the Company will announce it on tenai.kr and work to restore it within 30 days.
text.한판은 보안키를 등록할 때 보안키, 기기 종류(USB·PC), 기기 번호: When registering a key, Hanpan sends tenai.kr the key, the device type (USB or PC), a hash of the device number and the time you agreed to keep the key on a PC; when checking status once a day, it sends the key number. These are used to verify keys and to enforce the limit of 3 per member.
text.한판은 문서 내용과 AI와 나눈 대화를 tenai.kr 로 보내지 않습니: Hanpan does not send your documents or your conversations with AI to tenai.kr.
text.한판을 지우려면 Windows 설정 → 앱 → 설치된 앱 → 한판 → 제: To remove Hanpan, go to Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps → Hanpan → Uninstall. Device information kept at tenai.kr is deleted as soon as you revoke the key.
Hanpan and security keys are provided free of charge.
text.보안키는 한판에 넣은 AI 서비스 키를 다른 사람이 쓰기 어렵게 돕는 장: A security key helps make it harder for others to use the AI service keys you put in Hanpan; it does not promise complete protection. Members manage their AI service keys and the related charges.
text.회사는 고의 또는 중대한 과실이 없는 한, 한판이 잠기거나 보안키를 쓰지: Unless it acted intentionally or with gross negligence, the Company is not liable for losses caused by Hanpan locking or a key being unusable.
When changing these terms, the Company gives notice in the same way as Article 3 of the Terms of Use. Changes unfavorable to keys already issued are announced 30 days before they take effect. When you get a new key, you agree to the terms in force at that time.
These terms take effect on November 20, 2026.

These terms do not limit the rights granted by the Apache License 2.0. What they govern is the use of the security keys the Company issues to members.
